title: Troponin diagnostic-accuracy review
goal: A clinical researcher can trace diagnostic-accuracy evidence from 1,260 records to 38 studies.

rubric.must: The standard PRISMA four-row flow is visibly present.
The 1,260 identified, 260 removed, and 1,000 screened counts visibly reconcile.
Exclusion side boxes visibly total 790 and 172 at their stages.
The final box visibly reports 38 studies and 41 reports.
Flow connectors are directional and clear.

ideal.notes: Independently authored using visual-eval/exemplars/prisma/single/ideal.svg (b70f305aa4ed); rendered and visually reviewed. Source retained faithfully but provisional: 210 assessed reports minus 172 excluded leaves 38, while source declares 41 included reports and 38 studies.
